# Fixture provenance

All page content, wording, identifiers, layouts, vector shapes, classifications,
and expected geometry in this directory were created specifically for this
repository. No external documents, scans, personal data, customer data, or
third-party benchmark pages are included.

The PNG files and `corpus.v1.json` are generated by
`scripts/generate-ocr-quality-fixtures.mjs`. The generator uses the committed
Liberation Sans Regular and Bold font files and Sharp's pinned repository
dependency. It fixes page dimensions, nominal DPI metadata, text placement,
text length, colors, rotations, shapes, reading order, and expected polygons.
The corpus manifest records the generated byte size and SHA-256 digest of every
raster.

The `sourceLayer` labels in the mixed-content fixture are synthetic provenance
labels. The benchmark intentionally supplies the engine a flattened RGBA raster;
it does not claim to test PDF parsing or native-text extraction. Rotated cases
contain already-rotated raster pixels and are classified unsupported because the
current engine descriptor does not advertise orientation handling. The table
case tests unsupported layout classification, not cell extraction. The Cyrillic
case is unsupported because the bundled model manifest does not list that
script.

The malformed-RGBA case declares a byte-length mismatch. The resource-heavy
case declares dimensions beyond benchmark job limits. Neither case creates a
large file or performs a large allocation.

Regeneration is verified in the OCR test suite by comparing the generated
manifest and fixture hashes with the committed corpus.
